name: Overwing API
description: Overwing makes five products, all in this API. Preflight (/api/v1/preflight): one check of an unsigned Solana transaction against the caller's policy, answering allow or refuse before an agent signs it. Guardrails (/api/v1/evaluate): send any text and a rule set slug; receive a pass/fail/review verdict per rule and in aggregate, one recommended action (block, redact, review, allow) and calibrated confidence, typically in under 500 ms. Atlas (/api/v1/atlas): a registry of AI crawlers, fetchers and browser agents, and a lookup that says what a User-Agent claims to be and whether the claim can be verified. Beacon (/api/v1/beacon): one paid lookup that says whether a site is reachable by agents, that is whether they can find it, read it and use it; $1 over x402 at /api/x402/beacon, or $5 by card. Tower (/api/v1/tower): typed operations on legacy business systems, where each write is executed, sent to a person for review, or refused, with a signed receipt for every step; in pilot, against a mock adapter. POST /api/v1/evaluate and GET /api/v1/atlas/lookup work with no key, 10 calls a day each; everything else takes `Authorization: Bearer ow_live_...` from POST /api/v1/signup (Tower actions take an agent key, `ow_agent_...`). Every error is `{ "error": "..." }`. The same operations are available over MCP (hosted at /mcp, or the overwing-mcp npm package) and, for evaluate and lookup, over A2A at /a2a. Plain-text guide at /llms.txt; human-readable reference at /docs.
